# Bounded callback element result

Owned Java 8 real private static helper binds its sole class-bounded result formal through a complete callback with fixed known context input. The helper retains its original bound cast, while the separately compiled caller narrows to a concrete context only after recording the bound result. Opaque method replies remain independent of callback results.

Source and SDK-input variants freeze originals and observers; compare all definitions, metadata and Exceptions; compile all emitted Java; and exercise four routes, 20 modes twice, five Signature controls and eight wrong programs. Wrong Object replies fail inside the helper after callback effects; wrong bound-class replies fail later in the caller after its result snapshot. Null and actual input replies remain valid.
